name: Explore Mercado do Bolhão
description: Spend a Saturday morning at Porto's most iconic market. Browse stalls overflowing with fresh produce, cheese, and seafood, then grab a traditional lunch on the upper level.
longDescription:
Mercado do Bolhão is a historic municipal market in Porto, operating since 1914. It serves as a central hub for local vendors selling fresh food products, flowers, and other goods. The market is managed by the Porto City Council and aims to preserve traditional commerce while offering a modern shopping environment. It is a daily market, providing a consistent source of local produce for residents and visitors.

Visitors on May 2nd, 2026, can expect to explore two levels of stalls within the recently renovated historic building. The ground floor typically houses fresh produce, meats, fish, and flowers, while the upper level features restaurants and smaller shops. The atmosphere is generally busy, reflecting its role as a working market. The experience is self-guided, allowing individuals to browse at their own pace.

Entry to Mercado do Bolhão is free. The market is centrally located and easily accessible, approximately a 5-minute walk from Trindade metro station. It is also within walking distance of many central Porto attractions.
